_about: Things you build (D128). Each: id (never change it once used), name, size [width, height, depth] in metres (the placing ghost and the fit check; the shape is a stand-in until Tom's models: docs/BUILD_MODELS_BRIEF.md), kind (workbench: some recipes need one within 2.5 m; crate: a container holding 'holds' kg; collector: fills with rain, a bottle every 'minutes_per_bottle' minutes of play, up to 'bottles', outdoors only; barricade: stops people and bullets, 'hp' bullets' worth of hits), and name_pl. The recipe that builds it says places: 'build:<id>' (recipes.json).
